skills.name: Earthshatter
skills.desc: Slam the ground and split a marked wedge ahead: 230% weapon damage, plus a bonus that grows with your level. Foes are thrown back.

skills.name: Frost Nova
skills.desc: Burst a ring of ice out to 4 m, dealing cold damage and chilling everything hit for 3 s.

skills.name: Arc
skills.desc: Loose lightning at the nearest foe ahead. It leaps to 3 more nearby.

skills.name: War Cry
skills.desc: Roar: you and allies within 8 m deal +40% damage for 6 s, and nearby monsters turn on you. In the Battlegrounds it buffs only you.
